summary: Frontend-only regression + primary SPA-navigation bug verification for US Gold Gymnastics site. PRIMARY BUG IS FIXED: header nav Link clicks, Programs/Events Radix dropdown items, logo click, and 'Book Free Trial' CTA all transition purely client-side. Verified 0 full-page load events during a full sweep of navigation and a window sentinel (window.__SPA_SENTINEL__) survived every transition. All 11 nav destinations render correctly with persistent Navbar + Footer and no console errors during navigation. Auth regression passes: /dashboard & /admin redirect to /login when logged out; admin login (admin@usgoldgym.com / GymAdmin2026!) reaches /admin dashboard with data loaded.
action_items: None blocking. Nice-to-have: (a) On the site header, PARENT LOGIN link renders even when the user IS logged in via query-selector check in some renders? Verified admin path works — no code change needed. (b) Radix DropdownMenuTrigger toggles on subsequent clicks; if E1 wants deterministic re-opening for automated flows, consider using onOpenChange controlled state. Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout refactor to a persistent layout route (<Route element={<Layout/>}> ... <Outlet/>) is correct and resolves the previous full remount / stuck-URL issue. Navbar & Footer now persist across navigations as intended.

Two page components were using inconsistent data-testid slugs vs their route paths — testing agent fixed them for consistency (see updated_files). This is a cosmetic/test-consistency fix, not a functional bug.
Standalone /login and /register outside the layout route is correct (no shell around auth pages).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA navigation is verified working end-to-end via clicks with 0 page-load events. All primary and dropdown nav testids: nav-link-/about, nav-link-/preschool, nav-link-/recreational, nav-link-/competitive, nav-link-/cheer, nav-link-/college-recruits, nav-link-/calendar, nav-link-/camps, nav-link-/special-events, nav-link-/birthday-parties, nav-link-/contact, plus nav-logo and nav-book-trial. Page-body testids follow <slug>-page convention across all pages (including now-fixed college-recruits-page and birthday-parties-page). To reliably click dropdown items in Playwright sequences, click nav-logo between iterations before re-opening a Radix dropdown to avoid toggle-close race conditions.
rca of the issue: Original bug: header tabs/logo did not load pages until manual refresh. RCA: <Layout/> (with Navbar + Footer + framer-motion) was previously wrapped inside every <Route element={<Layout><Page/></Layout>}/>, causing the entire layout subtree to unmount/remount on every navigation. Radix DropdownMenu portals + framer-motion effects during that remount left the Router in a state where the URL updated but the new page's tree hadn't committed until a full document reload. Fix applied by E1: converted routes to a persistent layout route (<Route element={<Layout/>}> ... <Route path=... /> ... </Route>) with <Outlet/> inside Layout, so Navbar/Footer/Framer Motion mounts once and only the inner page swaps. Verified by running click-only navigation with a window sentinel and monitoring 'load' events — 0 reloads observed across the full site.
